reviewer: Native Codex delegated functional-role author; independent validation is separate

classification_policy.evidence_line_numbers: One-based inclusive lines in the exact repository artifact identified by SHA-256. SQL is redacted; original-definition hashes are separate.
classification_policy.vendor_mentions: Optional exact identifier mentions corroborate discoverability only; semantic equivalence is not established.

role_taxonomy.transactional_state: Stores mutable business-operation quantities, statuses or execution bookkeeping.
role_taxonomy.configuration: Stores parameters, definitions or rules that can govern behavior; values and activation were not inspected.
role_taxonomy.master_reference: Stores reusable identities and descriptive attributes referenced across operations.
role_taxonomy.execution_worklist: Represents warehouse instruction ordering, assignment and execution state; not the generic vendor process queue.
role_taxonomy.reporting_read_model: Projects or aggregates stored data for reading; does not imply materialization or measured workload.
role_taxonomy.presentation_metadata: Stores screen/control definitions, binding properties and display settings.
role_taxonomy.presentation_adapter: Builds result shapes or selections consumed by a user interface or print-selection flow.
role_taxonomy.orchestration: Coordinates conditional database calls or multiple implementation steps; caller transactions remain separate.
role_taxonomy.transactional_mutation: Contains explicit persistent INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE behavior affecting operational state.
role_taxonomy.integration_staging: Stores interface-shaped payloads and processing indicators; direction, transport and delivery need additional evidence.
role_taxonomy.audit_history: Stores events, changes or errors; completeness, retention and immutability are not established.
role_taxonomy.workflow_selection: Builds selection logic for executable warehouse work; not necessarily read-only.
role_taxonomy.utility_transform: Transforms input into derived values or structured parameters.
role_taxonomy.event_handler: Defines trigger behavior for a declared DML event; actual execution was not tested.

global_inference_limits: Only the listed 35 objects have reviewed role assignments; every other eligible object remains unreviewed.
Roles describe captured column/SQL responsibilities, not active configuration, records, invocation frequency or permissions.
Selected implementation spans support a role classification, not complete branch, caller, transaction, security or performance review.
No object is classified as runtime_queue from a scheduling/work name; absent vendor queue identifiers remain unresolved deployment evidence.
